suggestions.reason: Expectation 2 (ordering) is satisfied but with one exception: an additional 🔴 (CTA quality) appears after the 🟡 finding, breaking pure severity order. Consider clarifying whether the expectation requires perfect ordering throughout or just that majority of issues are grouped by severity

The eval does not explicitly test for 'narrative arc section includes all 8 required homepage sections and identifies missing sections'. The output correctly identifies missing sections (Problem stakes, System overview, etc.) but this important quality outcome is not explicitly asserted

The eval does not test whether the 'Rewrite' sections are themselves high-quality and follow brand guidelines. A rewrite could technically be present but poor. Consider adding an assertion like 'All rewrites use operational language and avoid generic SaaS filler'

eval_feedback.overall: Evals are solid. All 7 assertions pass with clear evidence. The expectations test the most important audit outcomes: format compliance, severity sorting, brand violation detection (journey, powerful/seamless, CTAs), and structural completeness (rewrites + gap matrix). Suggestions above are edge cases and nice-to-haves, not gaps in coverage.
